scope: Part (a): the actual triangle lower-tail log probability divided by n²p/2 converges to V(η^(1/3)), and its ratio to (n²p/2)V(η^(1/3)) converges to one, for every sequence n→∞, p→0 and √n p→∞. All triangle hypergraph identifications, codegrees, additive-error limits and perturbation squeezing are proved. Part (b), conditioned structure, remains.
